newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurd rebel inmate dies after protest in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Kurd rebel inmate dies after protest in Turkey.

text.p: A Kurd rebel prisoner has died in hospital 10 days after setting himself alight to protest at the deaths of 11 Kurdish prisoners in a southeastern jail, a human rights official of said on Wednesday.
"Vedat Aydemir died late last night," Saban Dayanan of the Human Rights Association told Reuters.
Aydemir and two other Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) prisoners poured paint thinner on their bodies and set themselves on fire in a cell at Istanbul's Bayrampasa prison late last month.
One inmate was in still a serious condition, Dayanan said.
They were protesting at the deaths of 11 PKK inmates during a riot at Diyarbakir high security jail in September.
More than 20,000 people have died since 1984 in clashes between government and PKK guerrillas fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
